summary.text: Jocelyn Torres is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 67, in the November 3, 2026 general election; she advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign described her as a first-generation college graduate from the University of North Carolina Greensboro who was born and raised in Stanly County.

paragraphs.text: Torres earned a high school diploma from Albemarle High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina Greensboro in 2023.
In her survey responses, she said she worked for the Stanly County school system.
The survey responses say her campaign centers on cost of living, fully funded public education, and support for local farmers and small businesses.
Her key messages are education, healthcare as a right, and boosting the local economy through workforce development.
